title: Total High Molecular Weight DNA Extraction from Plant Tissues for Long Read Sequencing
author: Subash Rai
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b5qyq5xw
materials: Dislodge the beads by inverting the tubes.
Assess DNA quality in NanoDrop, Qubit, and TapeStation/PFGE.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Equipment
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary materials for the extraction process.

substeps.instruction: Warm 10 mL lysis buffer at 60 °C for 15-20 min.
Prepare ~ 1 L of liquid nitrogen (LN2) in a Dewar Flask for chilling the mortar and pestle.
Prepare dry ice in an esky/insulated container.

steps.title: Grind Plant Tissue
steps.instruction: Pulverize the plant tissue into a fine powder using liquid nitrogen.

substeps.instruction: Grind 500 mg to 1000 mg of healthy young fresh, snap frozen, or frozen tissues in a mortar and pestle chilled with LN2 until a fine powder is formed.
Top up LN2 2-3 times during grinding if necessary.

steps.title: Transfer Tissue to Tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the ground powder to a chilled tube and remove excess liquid nitrogen.

substeps.instruction: Place a 15 mL falcon tube on dry ice for 5 minutes.
Swirl the ground powder with LN2 and pour it directly into the chilled falcon tube.
Keep the lid half-open to allow LN2 to evaporate.

steps.title: Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Lysis the tissue using prewarmed buffer and Proteinase K.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL prewarmed lysis buffer (60 °C) containing freshly added 200 µL β-mercaptoethanol to the tube.
Mix well by inverting the tube ~100 times until the solution is homogenous (whiteish clumps are normal).
Incubate at 60 °C in a thermomixer at 300 rpm for 1 hour.
Add 200 µL Proteinase K (stock concentration 20 mg/mL) after the first 20 minutes of incubation.
Mix well by inverting the tube 15-20 times and continue the incubation.

steps.title: Initial Clarification
steps.instruction: Cool the sample and remove cellular debris.

substeps.instruction: Allow the tube to cool to room temperature for 10 minutes.
Centrifuge the solution at 3000 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: First Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform the first phase separation to remove proteins.

substeps.instruction: Divide the supernatant into two fresh 15 mL falcon tubes using P1000 wide-bore pipette tips.
Add an equal volume of Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to the solution.
Mix by inverting the tube ~100 times until a milky color appears.
Centrifuge at 3000 x g for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a new 15 mL falcon tube without disturbing the interface layer.

steps.title: Second Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform a second phase separation for further purification.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of Chloroform:Isoamyl alcohol (24:1) to the aqueous phase.
Mix by inverting the tubes ~100 times.
Centrifuge at 3000 x g for 10 minutes.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a new 15 mL falcon tube without disturbing the interface layer.

steps.title: CTAB-DNA Complex Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA using dilution buffer and heat.

substeps.instruction: Add a double volume of dilution buffer to the aqueous phase.
Mix well by inverting the tubes.
Incubate in a thermomixer at 60 °C for 1 hour at 400 rpm.
Centrifuge at 3000 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Carefully remove the supernatant, leaving the loose white pellet of CTAB-DNA complex at the bottom.

steps.title: DNA Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet with ethanol to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet with 1 mL freshly prepared 70% ethanol using a wide-bore P1000 pipette tip and transfer to a 2 mL LoBind DNA tube.
Rinse the original 15 mL falcon tube with an additional 1 mL 70% ethanol to collect remaining complex and transfer to the 2 mL tube.
Incubate the 2 mL tubes for 5 minutes at room temperature in a HulaMixer at 9 rpm.
Centrifuge at 13000 x g for 5 minutes and discard the supernatant.
Repeat the washing process (resuspension and centrifugation) once more using 2 mL 70% ethanol.
Keep the tubes under a fume hood for 5 minutes to remove all traces of ethanol.

steps.title: DNA Resuspension and RNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA and remove RNA.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA pellet in 200 µL of prewarmed (60 °C) High-salt TE buffer.
Add 4 µL RNaseA and incubate at 37 °C for 15-20 min.

steps.title: Ammonium Acetate Precipitation
steps.instruction: Further purify the DNA using ammonium acetate.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL ammonium acetate (7.5 M) to the mixture.
Mix well and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature, shaking once every 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 13000 x g for 3 minutes.
Transfer the supernatant into a fresh tube using wide-bore pipette tips.

steps.title: Bead-Based Purification
steps.instruction: Use magnetic beads to isolate high molecular weight DNA.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of binding buffer and mix well by inverting the tube.
Add 150 µL beads solution (8-9 million beads) and incubate for 30 minutes at room temperature in a HulaMixer.
Place the tube in a magnetic rack for 2-3 minutes.
Remove the supernatant.
Wash the beads twice with 500 µL freshly prepared 70% ethanol; dislodge any bead clumps by inverting the tube several times.

steps.title: DNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 75 µL prewarmed (50 °C) 10 mM Tris-HCl (elution buffer) pH 8 and incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Place the tube in the magnetic rack for 5 minutes.
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh 1.5 mL LoBind DNA tube. If the eluate is too viscous for the beads to pellet, add more elution buffer or centrifuge at 13000 x g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Final Bead Wash
steps.instruction: Perform a final wash of the beads.

substeps.instruction: Remove tubes from the magnetic rack and add 500 µL freshly prepared 70% ethanol.
Place tubes back in the magnetic rack for 2 minutes and remove the supernatant.
